records.title_en: AI and Our Economic Future
records.title_cn: 人工智能和我们的经济未来
records.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) will likely be the most transformative technology of the modern era. What if machines—AI for cognitive tasks and AI plus advanced robots for physical tasks—can perform every task a human can? This essay makes three main points. First, even though US growth rates have been stable at roughly 2 percent per year for 150 years, it is distinctly possible that automating intelligence leads economic growth rates to accelerate. Second, this acceleration is likely to be slowed by the presence of "weak links." While we each have access to 100 million times more transistors on our desktop computer than people in the 1970s, we are not 100 million times more productive. Computers can invert matrices at lightning speed, but we humans must still decide what matrix to invert, what hypothesis to test, and so on. Accelerating economic growth requires the vast majority of the weak links to be automated away, which delays the large gains. Finally, even though weak links slow the benefits, they may actually speed up the risks. When a chain is only as strong as its weakest link, damaging one link in the chain can be very costly. A powerful AI that is superhuman at software engineering could be misused by a bad actor to do substantial harm by hacking the financial system or a virology lab.
records.abstract_cn: 人工智能（AI）很可能是现代最具变革性的技术。如果机器——用于认知任务的AI，以及用于物理任务的AI加先进机器人——能够执行人类可以执行的每一项任务，会怎样？本文提出三个主要观点。第一，尽管美国经济增长率在150年间大致稳定在每年2%，自动化智能完全可能使经济增长率加速。第二，这种加速很可能因“薄弱环节”的存在而放缓。虽然我们每个人能够使用的台式计算机晶体管数量，比1970年代的人多100000000倍，但我们的生产率并没有高出100000000倍。计算机可以以闪电般的速度求逆矩阵，但我们人类仍须决定要对哪个矩阵求逆、检验什么假设，等等。加速经济增长需要将绝大多数薄弱环节自动化消除，这会推迟巨大收益的实现。最后，尽管薄弱环节会减缓收益，它们实际上可能加速风险。当一条链的强度取决于最薄弱环节时，破坏链条中的一个环节可能付出高昂代价。一个在软件工程方面超越人类的强大人工智能，可能被恶意行为者滥用，通过入侵金融系统或病毒学实验室造成重大损害。

records.title_en: The Emerging Market for Intelligence: How Firms Buy and Sell AI
records.title_cn: 新兴的人工智能市场：企业如何买卖人工智能
records.abstract_en: We describe the emerging business-to-business market for large language model (LLM) inference and document key empirical patterns in its supply, pricing, and dynamics, using data from OpenRouter. First, supply has expanded rapidly: the number of commercially available models, model creators, and inference providers has grown sharply, driven heavily by open-source entrants. Second, the price of intelligence has fallen roughly a thousandfold, and open-source models now cost about 90 percent less than comparable closed-source ones. Third, the market is highly dynamic, with frequent turnover among leading models and creators. Fourth, we document substantial horizontal and vertical differentiation: no single model dominates across use cases, and demand for intelligence varies widely across applications. We place these patterns in historical perspective alongside earlier general-purpose technologies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用来自 OpenRouter 的数据描述了大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理的新兴企业对企业市场，并记录了其供应、定价和动态方面的关键经验模式。首先，供应迅速扩大：在开源进入者的大力推动下，商业模型、模型创建者和推理提供商的数量急剧增长。其次，情报的价格已经下降了大约一千倍，开源模型的成本现在比同类闭源模型低约 90%。第三，市场活跃度高，领军模特、创作者更替频繁。第四，我们记录了显着的水平和垂直差异：没有单一模型在用例中占主导地位，并且不同应用程序对智能的需求差异很大。我们将这些模式与早期的通用技术放在历史的角度来看。

records.title_en: US Tariff Policy since 1789
records.title_cn: 自1789以来的美国关税政策
records.abstract_en: We use a newly assembled, tariff-line-level dataset spanning the full history of US trade policy to revisit the evolution of tariffs since 1789. We document the institutional shift from Congressional setting to multilateral negotiation, the steady growth in granularity of the tariff code alongside expanding administrative capacity, and the under-appreciated role of specific tariffs, which feature prominently throughout US history and whose ad valorem equivalent moves mechanically with prices. We discuss the implications of this relationship for how we interpret past liberalization episodes and for empirical identification of tariff effects. Finally, we outline how the new data can advance research on the political economy of tariff-setting and on the macroeconomic and distributional consequences of trade policy.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用新组装的涵盖美国贸易政策完整历史的关税线级别数据集来重新审视自1789以来关税的演变。我们记录了从国会设置到多边谈判的制度转变、关税法规粒度的稳步增长以及行政能力的扩大，以及从量关税的作用被低估，这些关税在美国历史上占据着突出的地位，其从价等价物随着价格机械地变化。我们讨论了这种关系对于我们如何解释过去的自由化事件以及关税效应的实证识别的影响。最后，我们概述了新数据如何推进关税设定的政治经济学以及贸易政策的宏观经济和分配后果的研究。

records.title_en: Labor Market Responses to Tariffs: Frictions, Dynamics, and Policy Responses
records.title_cn: 劳动力市场对关税的反应：摩擦、动态和政策反应
records.abstract_en: This article introduces the evidence and associated modeling frameworks contemporary economists use to understand the effects of trade and trade policy on labor markets, with a particular emphasis on labor-market frictions and adjustment dynamics. The effects of trade shocks differ across industries, regions, and occupations, implying the presence of important adjustment frictions in labor markets, and these effects evolve slowly over time, implying the need for dynamic frameworks rationalizing slow transitions. After reviewing the key insights from this literature, we discuss policies aimed at mitigating costs to workers and ensuring that the gains from trade are shared more equitably.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了当代经济学家用来理解贸易和贸易政策对劳动力市场影响的证据和相关模型框架，特别强调劳动力市场摩擦和调整动态。贸易冲击的影响因行业、地区和职业而异，这意味着劳动力市场存在重要的调整摩擦，而且这些影响随着时间的推移缓慢演变，意味着需要动态框架来合理化缓慢的转型。在回顾了这些文献的主要见解后，我们讨论了旨在降低工人成本并确保更公平地分享贸易收益的政策。

records.title_en: Should We Tax Trade? A Pigouvian Perspective
records.title_cn: 我们应该对贸易征税吗？庇古的观点
records.abstract_en: We develop a simple and intuitive Pigouvian perspective on optimal trade policy. Our approach unifies a wide range of rationales for taxing trade, from the classical optimal tariff argument to contemporary debates about global carbon emissions and geopolitics. We also clarify when trade policy intervention is warranted and when alternative domestic instruments should be used instead.
records.abstract_cn: 我们对最优贸易政策提出了简单直观的庇古观点。我们的方法统一了对贸易征税的广泛理由，从经典的最优关税论点到当代有关全球碳排放和地缘政治的辩论。我们还澄清何时需要进行贸易政策干预以及何时应使用其他国内工具。

records.title_en: The Incidence of Tariffs: Rates and Reality
records.title_cn: 关税的发生率：税率与现实
records.abstract_en: In 2025, statutory tariff rates on US imports rose to levels not seen in over one hundred years. What were the implications for prices? On the one hand, shipping lags, exemptions, and enforcement gaps kept the actual implemented rates at only half of the statutory rates, moderating the tariffs' impact. On the other hand, tariff pass-through to US import prices reached 92 percent, so the United States bore a large share of the costs. We study the incidence of the 2018–2019 and 2025 US tariffs and discuss implications for US sourcing, domestic manufacturing costs, and the dollar.
records.abstract_cn: 2025，美国进口产品的法定关税税率升至一百多年来未见的水平。这对价格有何影响？一方面，运输滞后、豁免和执法差距使实际执行的税率仅为法定税率的一半，减轻了关税的影响。另一方面，关税对美国进口价格的转嫁达到92%，因此美国承担了很大一部分成本。我们研究 2018-2019 和 2025 美国关税的发生率，并讨论对美国采购、国内制造成本和美元的影响。

records.title_en: Global Imbalances, Tariffs, and Industrial Policy
records.title_cn: 全球失衡、关税和产业政策
records.abstract_en: Global imbalances denote the distribution of countries' current account balances, identically equal to the difference between two forward-looking aggregate variables: national saving and domestic investment. Industrial and trade policies have traditionally not been considered important drivers of aggregate saving or investment, and therefore of current account balances. The former because most industrial policies are small in scope; the latter because permanent tariffs have no intertemporal effect in the textbook model, with an offsetting appreciation of the real exchange rate. The rapidly growing use of both industrial and trade policies in recent years calls for a reassessment. This paper presents a framework to think about the role of both policies. For industrial policy, we make the important distinction between the traditional sector-specific policies via subsidies or other targeted instruments ("micro industrial policy") and broader policies ("macro industrial policy") that aim to promote industrial developments and competitiveness through the deployment of more aggregate instruments such as financial repression, foreign reserve accumulation, or capital controls. A key finding is that micro industrial policy tends to increase external balances if it fails to raise aggregate productivity. By contrast, macro industrial policy can, under some conditions, boost the current account, forcing other countries to adjust. Yet, these policies often come at the cost of suppressed domestic consumption and possibly domestic welfare. Our analysis confirms that tariffs are a weak tool to improve current account balances. Finally, traditional macroeconomic drivers—such as fiscal policy, demographics or credit cycles—remain critical drivers of global imbalances, especially for the United States and China.
records.abstract_cn: 全球失衡是指各国经常账户余额的分布，同样等于两个前瞻性总体变量：国民储蓄和国内投资之间的差额。传统上，工业和贸易政策不被视为总储蓄或投资的重要驱动因素，因此也不被视为经常账户余额的重要驱动因素。前者是因为大多数产业政策的范围较小；后者是因为大多数产业政策的范围较小。后者是因为永久关税在教科书模型中没有跨期效应，并会抵消实际汇率的升值。近年来，工业和贸易政策的使用迅速增加，需要重新评估。本文提出了一个思考这两项政策作用的框架。对于产业政策，我们对通过补贴或其他有针对性的工具（“微观产业政策”）的传统特定部门政策（“微观产业政策”）和更广泛的政策（“宏观产业政策”）进行了重要区分，后者旨在通过部署金融抑制、外汇储备积累或资本管制等更多总体工具来促进产业发展和竞争力。一个重要的发现是，如果微观产业政策不能提高总生产率，它往往会增加外部平衡。相比之下，宏观产业政策在某些情况下可以增加经常账户，迫使其他国家进行调整。然而，这些政策往往是以抑制国内消费和可能的国内福利为代价的。我们的分析证实，关税对于改善经常账户余额来说是一个较弱的工具。最后，财政政策、人口结构或信贷周期等传统宏观经济驱动因素仍然是全球失衡的关键驱动因素，尤其是对美国和中国而言。

records.title_en: Evaluating the Fiscal and Distributional Implications of Tariffs
records.title_cn: 评估关税的财政和分配影响
records.abstract_en: The Trump administration has enacted a series of significant taxes on imports, including an across-the-board tariff on nearly all imports. Tariffs are now expected to raise nearly 1 percent of GDP in revenue. Given tariffs' growing importance as a source of revenue, it is important to understand their implications for federal finances and the wellbeing of households. This paper describes and reviews current revenue and distributional analyses of tariffs.
records.abstract_cn: 特朗普政府对进口产品征收了一系列重大税款，包括对几乎所有进口产品征收全面关税。目前预计关税将增加近 1% 的 GDP 收入。鉴于关税作为收入来源的重要性日益增加，了解其对联邦财政和家庭福祉的影响非常重要。本文描述并回顾了当前的收入和关税分配分析。

records.title_en: Correct (and Incorrect) Inference with a Single Instrumental Variable: Practical Takeaways from the Weak Instruments Literature
records.title_cn: 使用单个工具变量进行正确（和不正确）的推断：弱工具文献的实用要点
records.abstract_en: Most empirical economists have encountered the warning that instrumental variables can be "weak," but the underlying issues—what makes an instrument weak, why weakness distorts inference, and what to do about it—are less widely understood. This article offers an accessible introduction to the weak instruments problem for the common just-identified case of a single endogenous regressor and a single instrument. We explain why the usual two-stage least squares t -ratio and its "±1.96 times the standard error" confidence interval can yield incorrect inferences, much as homoskedasticity-only standard errors do when errors are not homoskedastic. We then describe practical, robust-to-weak-instrument solutions—including the Anderson-Rubin and tF methods—that deliver valid confidence intervals whatever the instrument's true strength, and we offer some do's and don'ts, notably why the popular " F greater than 10" rule has no theoretical justification in this setting.
records.abstract_cn: 大多数实证经济学家都遇到过工具变量可能“弱”的警告，但根本问题——是什么导致工具弱，为什么弱会扭曲推论，以及如何应对——却不太被广泛理解。本文针对刚刚确定的单个内生回归量和单个工具的常见情况，对弱工具问题进行了简单易懂的介绍。我们解释了为什么通常的两阶段最小二乘 t 比及其“±1.96 乘以标准误差”置信区间可能会产生错误的推论，就像当误差不是同方差时仅同方差的标准误差一样。然后，我们描述实用的、稳健到弱的仪器解决方案（包括 Anderson-Rubin 和 tF 方法），无论仪器的真实强度如何，它们都能提供有效的置信区间，并且我们提供了一些注意事项，特别是为什么流行的“F 大于 10”规则在这种情况下没有理论依据。

records.title_en: Leniency Designs: An Operator's Manual
records.title_cn: 宽大设计：操作员手册
records.abstract_en: We develop a step-by-step guide to leniency (a.k.a. judge or examiner instrument) designs, drawing on recent econometric literatures. The unbiased jackknife instrumental variables estimator (UJIVE) is purpose-built for leveraging exogenous leniency variation, avoiding subtle biases even in the presence of many decision-makers or controls. We show how UJIVE can also be used to assess key assumptions underlying leniency designs, including quasi-random assignment and average first-stage monotonicity, and to probe the external validity of treatment effect estimates. We further discuss statistical inference, arguing that non-clustered standard errors are often appropriate. A reanalysis of Farre-Mensa et al. (2020), using quasi-random examiner assignment to estimate the value of patents to startups, illustrates our checklist.
records.abstract_cn: 我们借鉴最近的计量经济学文献，制定了宽大处理（又称法官或审查员工具）设计的分步指南。无偏折刀工具变量估计器 (UJIVE) 是专门为利用外生宽大变异而构建的，即使在存在许多决策者或控制的情况下也能避免细微的偏差。我们展示了如何使用 UJIVE 来评估宽大设计背后的关键假设，包括准随机分配和平均第一阶段单调性，并探讨治疗效果估计的外部有效性。我们进一步讨论统计推断，认为非聚集标准误差通常是合适的。 Farre-Mensa 等人的重新分析。 （2020）使用准随机审查员分配来估计专利对初创企业的价值，说明了我们的清单。

records.title_en: Stefanie Stantcheva, 2025 Clark Medalist
records.title_cn: 斯蒂芬妮·斯坦切娃 (Stefanie Stantcheva)，2025 克拉克奖章获得者
records.abstract_en: The American Economic Association awarded the 2025 John Bates Clark Medal to Stefanie Stantcheva of Harvard University. Her research ranges widely in the field of public economics. It includes theoretical contributions to optimal income taxation, empirical contributions to the study of how income tax rates across countries and states affect the mobility of inventors and the level of innovation, and contributions in the development and execution of on-line surveys to measure respondents' beliefs about economic primitives, such as the distribution of income or the rate of inflation, and the way these beliefs influence policy preferences. She has demonstrated that randomized controlled trials can be embedded within on-line surveys and used to the way informational interventions and other treatments affect economic beliefs and policy preferences.
records.abstract_cn: 美国经济协会将2025约翰·贝茨·克拉克奖章授予哈佛大学的斯蒂芬妮·斯坦切娃。她的研究广泛涉及公共经济学领域。它包括对最佳所得税的理论贡献，对研究不同国家和州的所得税税率如何影响发明者流动性和创新水平的实证贡献，以及对开发和执行在线调查的贡献，以衡量受访者对经济原语的信念，例如收入分配或通货膨胀率，以及这些信念影响政策偏好的方式。她证明，随机对照试验可以嵌入在线调查中，并用于研究信息干预和其他治疗方法影响经济信念和政策偏好的方式。

records.title_en: Markups Across Space and Time
records.title_cn: 跨空间与时间的加成率
records.abstract_en: In this article, we provide direct evidence on the behaviour of markups in the retail sector across space and time. Markups are measured using gross margins. We consider three levels of aggregation: the retail sector as a whole, the firm, and the product level. We find that: (1) markups are relatively stable over time and mildly procyclical; (2) there is a large regional dispersion in markups; (3) there is a positive cross-sectional correlation between local income and local markups; and (4) differences in markups across regions result from differences in the assortment of goods sold in different regions, not from deviations from uniform pricing. We propose a simple model consistent with these facts.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们提供了关于零售部门加成率在空间和时间上行为的直接证据。加成率使用毛利率来衡量。我们考虑三个层次的加总：整个零售部门、企业和产品层面。我们发现：(1) 加成率随时间相对稳定，并具有温和的顺周期性；(2) 加成率存在较大的区域差异；(3) 当地收入与当地加成率之间存在正向的横截面相关性；以及 (4) 不同区域间加成率的差异源于不同区域销售的商品种类差异，而非偏离统一定价。我们提出了一个与这些事实一致的简单模型。

records.title_en: The Macroeconomics of Irreversibility
records.title_cn: 不可逆性的宏观经济学
records.abstract_en: We study aggregate capital dynamics in an investment model with idiosyncratic productivity shocks, fixed capital adjustment costs, and irreversibility driven by a wedge between capital purchase and resale prices. We derive sufficient statistics that capture the role of investment frictions in aggregate capital fluctuations, measure these statistics using investment microdata, and exploit them to discipline the capital price wedge. Irreversibility doubles the persistence of capital fluctuations and is crucial for reconciling micro-level investment behaviour with macroeconomic propagation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个投资模型中的总体资本动态，该模型包含异质性生产率冲击、固定资本调整成本以及由资本购买价格与转售价格之间的楔子驱动的不可逆性。我们推导出捕捉投资摩擦在总体资本波动中作用的充分统计量，使用投资微观数据测量这些统计量，并利用它们来约束资本价格楔子。不可逆性使资本波动的持续性加倍，并且对于调和微观层面的投资行为与宏观经济传导至关重要。

records.title_en: Patent Term, Innovation, and the Role of Technology Disclosure Externalities
records.title_cn: 专利期限、创新与技术披露外部性的作用
records.abstract_en: I examine the impact of patent term on R&D and innovation in the presence of policy anticipation, common in real-world settings. Using a difference-in-difference design, I exploit quasi-experimental variation in US patent term across technological fields due to the ratification of TRIPs agreements in 1995. Despite a general increase in average patent term, in most fields innovators faced a considerable probability of patent term reduction for future innovations. Three key findings emerge: (1) R&D and innovation accelerate more in fields with a higher probability of patent term reduction, i.e. a shorter average patent term extension, before implementation. (2) This heightened activity persists for at least 5 years postimplementation, driven by indirect effects where the news-related acceleration fosters further innovation through technological externalities linked to cumulative knowledge creation. (3) Conversely, the direct effect of a shorter extension in patent term would stimulate relatively less innovation, absent the indirect effects of anticipation.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了在政策预期存在的情况下（这在现实世界中很常见），专利期限对研发和创新的影响。利用双重差分设计，我利用了因TRIPs协议在1995年批准而导致的美国各技术领域专利期限的准实验性变化。尽管平均专利期限普遍延长，但在大多数领域，创新者面临着相当大的未来创新专利期限缩短的可能性。出现了三个关键发现：（1）在实施前，专利期限缩短概率较高（即平均专利期限延长较短）的领域，研发和创新加速更多。（2）这种增强的活动在实施后至少持续5年，这是由间接效应驱动的，其中与新闻相关的加速通过累积知识创造相关的技术外部性促进了进一步的创新。（3）相反，如果没有预期的间接效应，专利期限缩短的直接效应将刺激相对较少的创新。

records.title_en: Diversification, Market Entry, and the Global Internet Backbone
records.title_cn: 多元化、市场进入与全球互联网骨干网
records.abstract_en: In many industries, buyers diversify their supplier base to manage supplier disruption risk. We investigate the importance of such diversification as a determinant of demand and supplier entry in the context of the internet backbone, the worldwide network of undersea fibre-optic cables that underpins the internet. We specify a model of international bandwidth demand and cable operators’ dynamic entry and supply choices. The model is estimated using novel data on cross-border data flows, prices, cable characteristics, and disruptions. Counterfactual analysis reveals that supplier diversification accounts for a large share of entry and surplus created between 2005 and 2021. Relative to the socially optimal level of entry, distortions due to suppliers’ inability to capture fully the social benefits of diversity are as large as distortions due to business stealing.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多行业中，买家会分散其供应商基础以管理供应商中断风险。我们研究了这种多元化作为需求和供应商进入决定因素的重要性，背景是互联网骨干网——支撑互联网的全球海底光缆网络。我们构建了一个国际带宽需求和电缆运营商动态进入及供应选择的模型。该模型使用关于跨境数据流量、价格、电缆特性和中断的新数据进行估计。反事实分析显示，供应商多元化解释了2005至2021期间创造的进入和剩余中的很大一部分。相对于社会最优进入水平，由于供应商无法完全获取多元化的社会效益而导致的扭曲，与因业务窃取导致的扭曲一样大。

records.title_en: Inflation Risk and the Finance-Growth Nexus
records.title_cn: 通胀风险与金融-增长关系
records.abstract_en: When firms finance using long-term nominal debt issued by financial intermediaries, changes in expected inflation lead to a wealth transfer across sectors. Higher expected inflation decreases firms’ real liabilities and default risk, which helps reduce debt overhang. However, it hurts intermediaries’ real assets, leading to a contraction in credit supply. We theoretically demonstrate that intermediary financing conditions play a key role in the transmission of nominal shocks, influencing the premium investors require for bearing inflation risk. We provide empirical evidence supporting our novel inflation transmission mechanism and connect our findings to the banking stress of 2023. We also show that Taylor rules responding to both financial and real variables can help stabilise our economy.
records.abstract_cn: 当企业通过金融中介发行的长期名义债务进行融资时，预期通胀的变化会导致跨部门的财富转移。更高的预期通胀降低了企业的实际负债和违约风险，有助于减少债务积压。然而，这损害了中介机构的实际资产，导致信贷供给收缩。我们从理论上证明，中介融资条件在名义冲击的传导中发挥关键作用，影响投资者为承担通胀风险所要求的溢价。我们提供了支持我们新颖的通胀传导机制的实证证据，并将我们的发现与2023的银行业压力联系起来。我们还表明，同时响应金融和实际变量的泰勒规则有助于稳定我们的经济。

records.title_en: Education and the Margins of Cyclical Adjustment in the Labour Market
records.title_cn: 教育与劳动力市场周期性调整的边际
records.abstract_en: Allocative wages—the labour costs considered when deciding to form or dissolve a long-term employment relationship—are more sensitive to cyclical conditions for more educated workers. Specifically, college-educated workers’ allocative wages are highly pro-cyclical, while high school dropouts’ wages exhibit only moderate cyclicality. Further, as education increases, an increasing share of the sensitivity of allocative wages is driven by the persistent scarring effects of the cyclical position at the time of hiring on the wages associated with higher levels of tenure, amounting to more than a third of the overall sensitivity for the college educated. The greater job stability of the more educated—and therefore the exposure to scarring—contributes to these differences. In addition, more significant scarring at each horizon of tenure amplifies the effect. In service of documenting these facts, I develop new methods for inferring the sensitivity of labour costs to shocks when agents are forward-looking and wages may be intertemporally smoothed.
records.abstract_cn: 配置性工资——即在决定建立或解除长期雇佣关系时所考虑的劳动力成本——对于受教育程度更高的工人而言，对周期性条件的敏感度更高。具体来说，受过大学教育的工人的配置性工资具有高度顺周期性，而高中辍学者的工资仅表现出适度的周期性。此外，随着教育程度的提高，配置性工资敏感度中越来越大的份额是由雇佣时周期性位置的持续疤痕效应对更高任期水平工资的影响所驱动的，对于受过大学教育的人来说，这占总体敏感度的三分之一以上。受教育程度更高的工人具有更大的工作稳定性——因此暴露于疤痕效应——导致了这些差异。此外，在每个任期水平上更显著的疤痕效应放大了这一影响。为了记录这些事实，我开发了新方法，用于在代理人具有前瞻性且工资可能进行跨期平滑的情况下推断劳动力成本对冲击的敏感度。

records.title_en: The Illiquidity of Water Markets
records.title_cn: 水市场的非流动性
records.abstract_en: We investigate the efficiency of a market relative to a non-market institution—an auction relative to a quota—as allocation mechanisms in the presence of frictions. We use data from water markets in southeastern Spain and explore a specific change in the institutions to allocate water. On the one hand, frictions arose because poor farmers were liquidity constrained. On the other hand, farmers who were part of the wealthy elite were not liquidity constrained. We estimate a structural dynamic demand model by taking advantage of the fact that water demand for both types of farmers is determined by the technological constraint imposed by the crop’s production function. This approach allows us to differentiate liquidity constraints from unobserved heterogeneity. We show that the institutional change from an auction to a quota increased total efficiency for the farmers considered. Welfare increased by 23.4 real pesetas per farmer per tree, a 6 % increase in total production relative to the market.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在存在摩擦的情况下，市场相对于非市场制度——拍卖相对于配额——作为分配机制的效率。我们使用了西班牙东南部水市场的数据，并探讨了水资源分配制度的具体变化。一方面，摩擦的产生是因为贫困农民受到流动性约束。另一方面，富裕精英阶层的农民则不受流动性约束。我们利用两类农民的水需求由作物生产函数所施加的技术约束决定这一事实，估计了一个结构性动态需求模型。这种方法使我们能够区分流动性约束与不可观测的异质性。我们表明，从拍卖到配额的制度变化提高了所考虑农民的总效率。福利增加了23.4真实比塞塔每农民每棵树，相对于市场，总产量增加了6%。

records.title_en: Selection in Surveys: Using Randomized Incentives to Detect and Account for Nonresponse Bias
records.title_cn: 调查中的选择：使用随机激励检测并解释无回应偏差
records.abstract_en: We show how to use randomized participation incentives to test and account for nonresponse bias in surveys. We first use data from a survey about labour market conditions, linked to full-population administrative data, to provide evidence of large differences in labour market outcomes between survey participants and nonparticipants, differences which would not be observable to an analyst who only has access to the survey data. These differences persist even after correcting for observable characteristics. We then use the randomized incentives in our survey to directly test for nonresponse bias and find evidence of substantial bias. Next, we apply a range of existing methods that account for nonresponse bias and find they produce bounds (or point estimates) that are either wide or far from the ground truth. We investigate the failure of these methods by taking a closer look at the determinants of participation, finding that the composition of participants changes in opposite directions in response to incentives and reminder emails. We develop a model of participation that allows for two dimensions of unobserved heterogeneity in the participation decision. Applying the model to our data produces bounds (or point estimates) that are narrower and closer to the ground truth than the other methods. Our results highlight the benefits of including randomized participation incentives in surveys. Both the testing procedure and the methods for bias adjustment may be attractive tools for researchers who are able to embed randomized incentives into their survey.
records.abstract_cn: 我们展示了如何使用随机参与激励来检验并解释调查中的无回应偏差。我们首先使用一项关于劳动力市场状况的调查数据，该数据与全人口行政数据相关联，提供了调查参与者和非参与者之间劳动力市场结果存在巨大差异的证据，这些差异对于仅能获取调查数据的分析者而言是无法观察到的。即使在校正了可观察特征之后，这些差异仍然存在。接着，我们利用调查中的随机激励直接检验无回应偏差，并发现了显著偏差的证据。然后，我们应用了一系列现有的处理无回应偏差的方法，发现它们产生的界限（或点估计）要么过宽，要么远离真实值。我们通过更仔细地审视参与的决定因素来调查这些方法的失败原因，发现参与者的构成对激励和提醒邮件的反应方向相反。我们开发了一个参与模型，允许参与决策中存在两个维度的不可观测异质性。将模型应用于我们的数据，产生的界限（或点估计）比其他方法更窄且更接近真实值。我们的结果凸显了在调查中纳入随机参与激励的好处。检验程序和偏差调整方法都可能成为能够将随机激励嵌入其调查的研究人员的有吸引力的工具。

records.title_en: Devaluations, Deposit Dollarization, and Household Heterogeneity
records.title_cn: 贬值、存款美元化与家庭异质性
records.abstract_en: We study the aggregate and redistributive effects of currency devaluations in a small open economy model with leverage-constrained banks and heterogeneous households. Our framework captures three stylized facts about financial dollarization in emerging economies: (1) a sizable share of domestic deposits is denominated in foreign currency; (2) these deposits represent significant foreign currency liabilities for local banks; and (3) dollar deposits are mainly held by wealthier households. A devaluation increases the real burden of foreign currency debt, causing an erosion of banks’ net worth, which depresses credit supply and economic activity. While richer households are partially insulated through their dollar deposits, poorer households cut consumption sharply in response to rising borrowing costs and falling real labor income. In our model deposit, dollarization amplifies the contractionary effects of a devaluation on output, investment, and consumption, in line with new empirical evidence for emerging economies. To achieve this result, both constrained intermediaries and heterogeneous households are crucial. In our framework, regulating dollarization can result in widespread welfare gains, especially for poorer households.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在具有杠杆约束银行和异质性家庭的小型开放经济模型中，货币贬值的总量效应和再分配效应。我们的框架捕捉了新兴经济体金融美元化的三个典型事实：(1) 国内存款中有相当大比例以外币计价；(2) 这些存款对当地银行而言代表了显著的外币负债；(3) 美元存款主要由较富裕的家庭持有。贬值增加了外币债务的实际负担，导致银行净值侵蚀，从而抑制信贷供给和经济活动。虽然较富裕的家庭通过其美元存款在一定程度上受到保护，但较贫穷的家庭因借贷成本上升和实际劳动收入下降而大幅削减消费。在我们的模型中，存款美元化放大了贬值对产出、投资和消费的紧缩效应，这与新兴经济体的新经验证据一致。要实现这一结果，受约束的中介机构和异质性家庭都至关重要。在我们的框架中，对美元化进行监管可以带来广泛的福利收益，尤其是对较贫穷的家庭而言。

records.title_en: Life-Cycle Wages and Human Capital Investments: Selection and Missing Data
records.title_cn: 生命周期工资与人力资本投资：选择与缺失数据
records.abstract_en: We derive wage equations with individual-specific coefficients from a structural model of human capital investment over the life-cycle. This model allows for interruptions in labour market participation and deals with missing data and attrition problems. We propose a new framework that deals with missingness at random and is based on factor decompositions that allow for flexible control of selection. Our approach leads to an interactive effect wage specification, which we estimate using long administrative panel data on male wages in the private sector in France. A structural function approach shows that interruptions negatively affect average wages. Interestingly, they also negatively affect the inter-decile range of wages after twenty years. This is only partly due to the fact that interruptions are endogenous.
records.abstract_cn: 我们从生命周期中人力资本投资的结构模型中推导出具有个体特定系数的工资方程。该模型允许劳动力市场参与中断，并处理缺失数据和损耗问题。我们提出了一个新框架，该框架处理随机缺失，并基于允许灵活控制选择的因子分解。我们的方法导致了一个交互效应工资规范，我们使用法国私营部门男性工资的长期行政面板数据对其进行估计。结构函数方法表明，中断对平均工资产生负面影响。有趣的是，它们还对二十年后的工资十分位距产生负面影响。这仅部分归因于中断是内生的这一事实。

records.title_en: Bank Information Production Over the Business Cycle
records.title_cn: 银行信息生产与经济周期
records.abstract_en: The information banks produce drives their lending decisions and macroeconomic outcomes, but this information is inherently difficult to analyse because it is private. We construct a novel measure of bank information quality from confidential regulatory data that include banks’ private risk assessments for US corporate loans. Information quality improves as local economic conditions deteriorate, particularly for new loans, large loans, and loans with higher expected losses. Information quality also declines during periods of rapid local house price appreciation. Our results provide empirical support for theories of countercyclical information production in credit markets.
records.abstract_cn: 银行产生的信息驱动着它们的贷款决策和宏观经济结果，但这类信息本质上是私密的，因此难以分析。我们利用包含美国公司贷款私人风险评估的机密监管数据，构建了一个衡量银行信息质量的新指标。当地方经济状况恶化时，信息质量会提高，尤其是对于新贷款、大额贷款和预期损失较高的贷款。在地方房价快速上涨期间，信息质量也会下降。我们的结果为信贷市场中信息生产的逆周期理论提供了实证支持。

records.title_en: The Economics of Equilibrium with Indivisible Goods
records.title_cn: 不可分割商品均衡的经济学
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a theory of competitive equilibrium with indivisible goods based entirely on economic conditions on demand. The key idea is to analyze complementarity and substitutability between bundles of goods, rather than merely between goods themselves. This approach allows us to formulate sufficient and essentially necessary conditions for equilibrium existence—which unify settings with complements and settings with substitutes. Our analysis has implications for auction design.
records.abstract_cn: 本文基于完全的需求经济条件，发展了一套不可分割商品竞争均衡理论。关键思想在于分析商品束之间的互补性与替代性，而非仅仅分析商品本身之间的互补性与替代性。这一方法使我们能够提出均衡存在的充分且本质上必要的条件——这些条件统一了具有互补品和具有替代品的情形。我们的分析对拍卖设计具有启示意义。

records.title_en: Latent Heterogeneity in the Marginal Propensity to Consume
records.title_cn: 边际消费倾向中的潜在异质性
records.abstract_en: We estimate the unconditional distribution of the marginal propensity to consume (MPC) using clustering regression applied to the 2008 economic stimulus payments. By deviating from the standard approach of estimating MPC heterogeneity using interactions with observables, we can recover the full distribution of MPCs. We find households spent between 4 and 133% of the rebate within a quarter, and individual households used rebates for different goods. While many observable characteristics correlate individually with our estimated MPCs, most of these relationships disappear when tested jointly. Notable exceptions are income and the average propensity to consume, which correlate positively with the MPC. Household observable characteristics explain only 8% of MPC variation, highlighting the role of latent heterogeneity.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用聚类回归方法应用于2008经济刺激支付，估计了边际消费倾向（MPC）的无条件分布。通过偏离使用可观测变量交互项来估计MPC异质性的标准方法，我们能够恢复MPC的完整分布。我们发现，家庭在一个季度内花费了退税的4至133%，且不同家庭将退税用于不同商品。虽然许多可观测特征与我们的估计MPC单独相关，但在联合检验时，这些关系大多消失。显著的例外是收入和平均消费倾向，它们与MPC正相关。家庭可观测特征仅解释了MPC变异的8%，凸显了潜在异质性的作用。

records.title_en: A Robust Test for Weak Instruments for 2SLS with Multiple Endogenous Regressors
records.title_cn: 多个内生回归变量下2SLS弱工具变量的稳健检验
records.abstract_en: We develop a test for instrument strength based on the bias of two-stage least squares (2SLS) that (1) generalizes Stock and Yogo’s and Sanderson and Windmeijer’s tests to be robust to heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation, and (2) extends Montiel Olea and Pflueger’s robust test for models with a single endogenous regressor to multiple endogenous regressors. Our test can be based either on an absolute bias criterion or on the 2SLS bias relative to a worst-case benchmark. We also develop extensions to test whether weak instruments cause bias in individual 2SLS coefficients. In simulations, our test controls size and is powerful, and we provide efficient code packages for its practical implementation. We demonstrate our testing procedures in the context of the estimation of state-dependent fiscal multipliers, following recent leading estimates.
records.abstract_cn: 我们基于两阶段最小二乘（2SLS）的偏误开发了一种工具变量强度检验，该检验（1）将Stock和Yogo以及Sanderson和Windmeijer的检验推广为对异方差和自相关稳健，并且（2）将Montiel Olea和Pflueger针对单一内生回归变量模型的稳健检验扩展到多个内生回归变量。我们的检验既可以基于绝对偏误准则，也可以基于相对于最坏情况基准的2SLS偏误。我们还开发了扩展，以检验弱工具变量是否导致单个2SLS系数产生偏误。在模拟中，我们的检验控制了规模且具有功效，我们提供了高效代码包以供实际实施。我们以状态依赖财政乘数的估计为背景，遵循近期领先的估计，展示了我们的检验程序。

records.title_en: Firm Quality Dynamics and the Slippery Slope of Credit Intervention
records.title_cn: 企业质量动态与信贷干预的滑坡效应
records.abstract_en: A salient trend in crisis intervention has emerged in recent decades: government and central banks have offered funding directly to nonfinancial firms, bypassing banks and other credit intermediaries. We analyse the long-term consequences of such policies by focussing on firm quality dynamics. In a laissez-faire economy, firms with high productivity are more likely to survive crises than those with low productivity. The government funding support saves more firms but cannot be customized based on firm productivity, dampening the cleansing effect of crises. The policy distortion is self-perpetuating: a downward bias in the firm quality distribution necessitates larger interventions in future crises. Our mechanism is quantitatively important: we show that if policymakers ignore such distortionary effects on firm quality dynamics, the resultant credit intervention would almost double the optimal amount.
records.abstract_cn: 近几十年来，危机干预出现了一个显著趋势：政府和中央银行绕过银行及其他信贷中介，直接向非金融企业提供资金。我们通过聚焦企业质量动态来分析此类政策的长期后果。在自由放任经济中，高生产率企业比低生产率企业更有可能在危机中幸存。政府资金支持拯救了更多企业，但无法基于企业生产率进行定制，从而削弱了危机的净化效应。政策扭曲具有自我延续性：企业质量分布的下行偏差使得未来危机中需要更大规模的干预。我们的机制在数量上具有重要意义：我们表明，如果政策制定者忽视这种对企业质量动态的扭曲效应，由此产生的信贷干预规模将几乎是最优水平的两倍。

records.title_en: Choice and Opportunity Costs
records.title_cn: 选择与机会成本
records.abstract_en: We define the (physical) opportunity cost of a choice x as the alternative that would be chosen if x were not available, and the opportunity cost of any unchosen alternative as x itself. The agent has preferences over pairs consisting of alternatives and their opportunity costs. Because costs affect choice and vice-versa, choice results from an intrapersonal equilibrium rather than from simple maximisation. In spite of significant rationality assumptions, the resulting behaviour can be highly non-standard, allowing intransitive choices. Rational utility maximisation is ensured by an additional new consistency condition on preferences. However, we argue that the maximised utility cannot be straightforwardly interpreted as a welfare relevant “revealed preference”. A generalisation of our model accommodates additional departures from standard rationality in the form of menu effects.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将选择x的（实物）机会成本定义为：若x不可获得时将被选择的替代方案，而任何未被选择的替代方案的机会成本则为x本身。行为主体对由替代方案及其机会成本组成的配对具有偏好。由于成本影响选择，反之亦然，选择源于个体内部均衡而非简单最大化。尽管存在显著的理性假设，由此产生的行为可能高度非标准，允许出现不可传递的选择。理性的效用最大化通过一个额外的关于偏好的新一致性条件得以确保。然而，我们认为最大化的效用不能直接解释为福利相关的“显示性偏好”。我们模型的一个推广形式以菜单效应的形式容纳了偏离标准理性的额外情形。

records.title_en: Bridges
records.title_cn: 桥梁
records.abstract_en: Bridges are critical but sparse links in land transport networks. I exploit quasi-experimental variation in bridge construction over major rivers in the U.S. to measure the causal effects of land transport infrastructure. Bridges are more often built upstream than downstream of tributary confluences—where smaller rivers join larger rivers—generating local differences in connectivity. Local connectivity advantages have negative effects on per capita income. In contrast, more substantial changes in connectivity arising from the opening of major bridges increase per capita economic activity. A narrative explanation that can reconcile both results is that land transport infrastructure creates productivity advantages that drive economic growth, structural transformation, and urbanization over large spatial scales, but local sorting within the cities that form around early transport routes then reverses this gradient over smaller spatial scales.
records.abstract_cn: 桥梁是陆路交通网络中至关重要但稀疏的连接点。我利用美国主要河流上桥梁建设的准实验性变化来衡量陆路交通基础设施的因果效应。桥梁更常建在支流汇合处的上游——即较小河流汇入较大河流之处——从而产生局部连通性的差异。局部连通性优势对人均收入有负面影响。相比之下，由主要桥梁开通引起的更显著的连通性变化则增加了人均经济活动。能够调和这两种结果的叙事性解释是，陆路交通基础设施创造了生产力优势，在大空间尺度上推动经济增长、结构转型和城市化，但围绕早期交通路线形成的城市内部的局部排序随后在较小空间尺度上逆转了这一梯度。

records.title_en: Costly Multidimensional Screening
records.title_cn: 高成本多维筛选
records.abstract_en: A screening instrument is costly if it is socially wasteful and productive otherwise. A principal screens an agent with multidimensional private information and quasilinear preferences that are additively separable across two components: a one-dimensional productive component and a multidimensional costly component. Can the principal improve upon simple one-dimensional mechanisms by also using the costly instruments? We show that if the agent has preferences between the two components that are positively correlated in a suitably defined sense, then simply screening the productive component is optimal. The result holds for general type and allocation spaces, and allows for nonlinear and interdependent valuations. We discuss applications to monopoly pricing, bundling, and labour market screening.
records.abstract_cn: 如果一种筛选工具在社会上是浪费的，而另一种则是生产性的，那么这种筛选工具就是高成本的。委托人筛选具有多维私人信息和拟线性偏好的代理人，这些偏好可加性地分离为两个组成部分：一个一维生产性组成部分和一个多维高成本组成部分。委托人能否通过同时使用高成本工具来改进简单的一维机制？我们证明，如果代理人对这两个组成部分的偏好在适当定义的意义上是正相关的，那么仅筛选生产性组成部分就是最优的。该结果适用于一般的类型和配置空间，并允许非线性和相互依存的估值。我们讨论了在垄断定价、捆绑销售和劳动力市场筛选中的应用。

records.title_en: Impacts of contemporaneous air pollution exposure on cognitive performance in Kenya
records.title_cn: 同期空气污染暴露对肯尼亚认知表现的影响
records.abstract_en: We estimate the short-term cognitive effects of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) exposure using novel exposure data collected during cognitive testing in Kenya. Unlike most existing studies that rely on satellite-based or fixed monitoring station data, we measure highly localized ambient pollution using portable monitors deployed at cognitive testing sites and link these readings directly to Harmonized Cognitive Assessment Protocol (HCAP) scores. Higher PM2.5 exposure during testing is associated with lower cognitive performance, particularly in executive function, memory, and visuospatial tasks. Binned exposure models suggest a monotonic pattern, with more negative estimates at higher exposure levels. Notably, effects are significantly larger among more educated individuals, possibly due to greater task demands or lower chronic exposure that limits physiological adaptation. Given that cognitive impairment is evident even at PM2.5 levels below Kenya’s mean annual regulatory threshold of 35μg/m3, the findings suggest that short-term exposure may impose underappreciated human capital costs that current regulatory standards fail to mitigate. The results highlight the potential cognitive and economic returns to interventions that reduce air pollution exposures in low-resource settings.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用在肯尼亚认知测试期间收集的新型暴露数据，估计了细颗粒物（PM2.5）暴露的短期认知效应。与大多数依赖卫星或固定监测站数据的现有研究不同，我们使用在认知测试地点部署的便携式监测器测量高度局部的环境污染物，并将这些读数直接与协调认知评估协议（HCAP）分数相关联。测试期间较高的PM2.5暴露与较低的认知表现相关，特别是在执行功能、记忆和视觉空间任务中。分箱暴露模型显示出单调模式，在较高暴露水平下估计值更为负面。值得注意的是，在受教育程度较高的个体中，效应显著更大，这可能是由于更高的任务需求或较低的慢性暴露限制了生理适应。鉴于即使在低于肯尼亚年均监管阈值35μg/m3的PM2.5水平下，认知损害也显而易见，这些发现表明短期暴露可能带来未被充分认识的人力资本成本，而当前监管标准未能缓解这些成本。结果凸显了在资源匮乏环境中减少空气污染暴露的干预措施可能带来的认知和经济回报。

records.title_en: The effect of health insurance expansion on price and demand for medications among the uninsured
records.title_cn: 医疗保险扩展对无保险人群药品价格和需求的影响
records.abstract_en: Social health insurance expansions can affect not only new beneficiaries but also those who remain outside the program. This paper studies these spillovers in the context of Medicare Part D. Increases in insured demand can raise or lower price depending on market conditions: they may increase price when pharmaceutical firms face less elastic demand, but reduce price when demand concentration strengthens bargaining and pass-through in competitive markets. I find that Part D lowered the out-of-pocket unit price paid by Americans under age 65 without prescription drug insurance. Price declines are larger in therapeutic classes more exposed to Part D and in classes with stronger within-class competition, consistent with a demand-concentration channel. Demand increases mainly for generic drugs and among existing users. The implied consumer-surplus gain is roughly $76 per person per year, comprising about $65 from lower price on inframarginal consumption and $11 from additional consumption. Demand responses appear strongest among lower-income, younger, and healthier uninsured individuals, consistent with greater pre-existing non-adherence. Although price fall across several drug classes, demand does not increase significantly for medications associated with greater overuse in the United States, suggesting potentially positive net health spillovers.
records.abstract_cn: 社会医疗保险扩展不仅会影响新受益者，也会影响那些仍处于计划之外的人群。本文在医疗保险D部分的背景下研究这些溢出效应。受保需求的增加可能根据市场条件提高或降低价格：当制药企业面临弹性较小的需求时，价格可能上升，但当需求集中增强议价能力和竞争市场中的传导时，价格可能下降。我发现，D部分降低了年龄在65岁以下且没有处方药保险的美国人的自付单位价格。价格下降在更受D部分影响的治疗类别和类别内竞争更强的类别中更为显著，这与需求集中渠道一致。需求增加主要发生在仿制药和现有使用者中。隐含的消费者剩余收益约为每人每年76美元，其中约65美元来自边际内消费的价格下降，11美元来自额外消费。需求响应在低收入、年轻和更健康的无保险个体中表现最强，这与先前存在的更大不依从性一致。尽管多种药物类别的价格下降，但与美国过度使用相关的药物的需求并未显著增加，这表明可能存在正向的净健康溢出效应。

records.title_en: Consolidation of Local Health Authorities and mortality in the Italian NHS
records.title_cn: 地方卫生当局的整合和意大利 NHS 的死亡率
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the health consequences of administrative centralization in healthcare, focusing on the consolidation of Local Health Authorities (LHAs) within the Italian National Health Service. This type of reform fits within a broader set of cost-containment efforts aimed at reducing administrative expenditures and exploiting economies of scale. In the Italian case, the reform centralized governance and expanded the scale of health administration, creating authorities with substantially larger catchment areas and shifting decision-making to more heterogeneous jurisdictions. Such changes may affect the responsiveness of healthcare provision to local needs, the coordination of service delivery, and access to care. Using an event-study Difference-in-Differences design, we estimate the policy’s impact on municipal mortality rates, accounting for heterogeneous treatment effects and co-occurring fiscal adjustment policies. We find a significant increase in mortality starting four years after implementation, with an average treatment effect on the treated of 2.1%. The effects are concentrated in municipalities belonging to absorbed LHAs and in those exposed to mergers involving relatively large pre-reform LHAs and substantial post-merger expansions in catchment areas; they are also unevenly distributed, creating new vulnerable areas. Welfare estimates based on life-years lost indicate that the monetary costs of increased mortality exceed plausible administrative savings by roughly an order of magnitude.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了医疗保健行政集中化对健康的影响，重点关注意大利国家卫生服务体系内地方卫生当局 (LHA) 的整合。此类改革适合旨在减少行政支出和利用规模经济的更广泛的成本控制努力。以意大利为例，改革集中了治理并扩大了卫生管理规模，建立了管辖范围更大的当局，并将决策权转移到更加多元化的司法管辖区。这些变化可能会影响医疗保健服务对当地需求的响应、服务提供的协调以及获得护理的机会。使用事件研究双重差分法设计，我们估计了该政策对城市死亡率的影响，并考虑了异质性治疗效果和同时发生的财政调整政策。我们发现实施四年后死亡率显着增加，平均治疗效果为2.1%。影响集中在属于被吸收的地方行政区的城市，以及那些受到涉及改革前相对较大的地方行政区合并以及合并后集水区大幅扩张的影响的城市；它们的分布也不均匀，造成了新的脆弱地区。基于生命损失年数的福利估计表明，死亡率增加的货币成本超出了合理的行政节省大约一个数量级。

records.title_en: Hospital Billing Regulations and Financial Well-being: Evidence from California’s Fair Pricing Law
records.title_cn: 医院账单规定与财务福祉：来自加州公平定价法的证据
records.abstract_en: We examine the financial consequences of the 2007 California Fair Pricing Law, which places a price ceiling on hospital bills for financially vulnerable individuals. Using cross-sectional variation in exposure to the law, proxied by county-level uninsured rates, we estimate its impact on individual financial outcomes. We find that the law reduces the likelihood of incurring non-medical debt in collections and the number of non-medical accounts in collections. In addition, we find evidence that credit scores increased and suggestive evidence that the number of delinquent accounts decreased for individuals in more exposed counties. Our results suggest hospital billing regulations can improve targeted individuals’ financial outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了2007年加州公平定价法的财务后果，该法对财务脆弱人群的医院账单设定了价格上限。利用法律暴露程度的横截面差异，以县级未保险率作为代理，我们估计了其对个人财务结果的影响。我们发现，该法降低了产生非医疗催收债务的可能性以及非医疗催收账户的数量。此外，我们发现证据表明，在暴露程度更高的县，个人信用评分有所提高，并且有提示性证据表明拖欠账户数量有所减少。我们的结果表明，医院账单规定可以改善目标人群的财务结果。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Competition between green and blue hydrogen and indirect network effects
records.title_cn: 绿氢和蓝氢之间的竞争和间接网络效应
records.abstract_en: Whereas hydrogen is currently a marginal energy carrier, the aim of the EU is to trigger low-carbon hydrogen production that covers around 10 percent of EU's energy needs by 2050. If this comes true, it will be an energy revolution. We study competition between green and blue hydrogen using an extended Salop model that encompasses the value chains for hydrogen and CCS. For blue hydrogen, we distinguish between exports of blue hydrogen—natural gas is converted into hydrogen close to the extraction site of natural gas and hydrogen is then transported over a long distance to the hydrogen consumers—and local production of blue hydrogen—natural gas is exported over a long distance and then converted into hydrogen near the hydrogen consumers. We find that mark-ups are highest in the case of exports of blue hydrogen production, which implies that total production of hydrogen, supply of blue hydrogen, and share of plants investing in carbon capture facilities are lower in the case of exports of blue hydrogen than in the case of local production of blue hydrogen. We provide numerical simulations of the alternative market outcomes and the corresponding first-best outcomes and identify policy instruments that should be used to sustain the first-best social outcomes in the cases of exports of blue hydrogen and local production of blue hydrogen.
records.abstract_cn: 鉴于氢目前是一种边际能源载体，欧盟的目标是在10%之前启动低碳氢生产，满足欧盟能源需求的2050左右。如果这成为现实，这将是一场能源革命。我们使用涵盖氢和 CCS 价值链的扩展 Salop 模型研究绿氢和蓝氢之间的竞争。对于蓝氢，我们区分出口蓝氢——天然气在靠近天然气提取地点转化为氢气，然后远距离运输到氢消费者；本地生产蓝氢——天然气长距离出口，然后在氢消费者附近转化为氢气。我们发现，出口蓝氢生产的加价最高，这意味着出口蓝氢的氢总产量、蓝氢供应量以及投资碳捕获设施的工厂比例低于本地生产蓝氢。我们提供了替代市场结果和相应的最佳结果的数值模拟，并确定了在出口蓝氢和本地生产蓝氢的情况下用于维持最佳社会结果的政策工具。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Testing for spillovers in resource conservation: Evidence from a natural field experiment
records.title_cn: 测试资源保护的溢出效应：来自自然现场实验的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies whether behavioral interventions designed to promote resource conservation in one domain generate spillovers in another. Using a natural field experiment involving over 2000 residents, we identify the direct and spillover effects of real-time feedback and social comparisons on water and energy consumption. We implement three interventions: two targeting shower use and one targeting air-conditioning use. We find significant reductions in shower use from both water-saving interventions, but no direct effect of the energy-saving intervention on air-conditioning use. For spillovers, we estimate precise null effects of water-saving interventions on air-conditioning use, and of the energy-saving intervention on shower use.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了旨在促进一个领域资源保护的行为干预措施是否会在另一个领域产生溢出效应。通过对2000多名居民进行的自然现场实验，我们确定了实时反馈和社会比较对水和能源消耗的直接和溢出效应。我们实施三项干预措施：两项针对淋浴的使用，一项针对空调的使用。我们发现，两种节水干预措施都显着减少了淋浴的使用，但节能干预措施对空调的使用没有直接影响。对于溢出效应，我们精确估计了节水干预措施对空调使用的零效应，以及节能干预措施对淋浴使用的零效应。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: The regional economic impact of weather shocks: Evidence from Portugal
records.title_cn: 天气冲击对区域经济的影响：来自葡萄牙的证据
records.abstract_en: Weather extremes shape short-run economic activity through both market and nonmarket channels, yet evidence on local consumer-side activity remains limited. Using a municipality-level panel of Portuguese data (2010–2021), we estimate panel VAR and local-projection responses to weather shocks of point-of-sale purchases (a measure of merchant-location transaction activity, not resident household consumption), together with unemployment and house prices. Our central methodological finding is that hourly rather than daily measurement of rainfall variability raises the estimated semi-elasticities by an order of magnitude, suggesting that the existing climate-economy literature systematically understates the importance of high-intensity rainfall. Substantively, the local-projection responses indicate that hourly rainfall volatility raises purchases on impact and reverses the following quarter, consistent with intertemporal reallocation; temperature variability generates a sharp positive impact effect followed by a contraction; and high fire-danger days raise contemporaneous purchases. Unemployment and house prices follow the same patterns more weakly. Regional heterogeneity is substantial, with the Lisbon Metropolitan Area and the Algarve sometimes displaying effects opposite in sign to those in the North.
records.abstract_cn: 极端天气通过市场和非市场渠道影响短期经济活动，但有关当地消费者活动的证据仍然有限。使用葡萄牙的市级面板数据（2010-2021），我们估计面板VAR和当地预测对销售点购买的天气冲击（衡量商家所在地交易活动，而不是居民家庭消费）的反应，以及失业率和房价。我们的主要方法论发现是，每小时而不是每天测量降雨变化将估计的半弹性提高了一个数量级，这表明现有的气候经济文献系统地低估了高强度降雨的重要性。从本质上讲，当地预测响应表明，每小时降雨量波动会增加购买量，并在下个季度出现逆转，这与跨期重新分配一致；温度变化会产生剧烈的积极影响，随后出现收缩；火灾危险高的日子会增加同期购买量。失业率和房价遵循同样的模式，但表现更为疲软。区域异质性很大，里斯本大都市区和阿尔加维有时会表现出与北部相反的效果。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Heterogeneous effects of weather shocks on firm economic performance
records.title_cn: 天气冲击对企业经济绩效的异质影响
records.abstract_en: This paper provides novel firm-level estimates of the economic damages caused by temperature shocks to European firms. I rely on a panel data analysis to show wide heterogeneities in the impact of temperature shocks, which depend on firm characteristics. This paper reveals the importance of micro-level data for quantifying climate damage estimates, as the average relationship between temperature and economic outcomes masks firms’ different susceptibilities to weather shocks. These create both winners and losers, harming less productive firms, particularly those in warmer regions, while benefiting more productive ones. Compared with the pooled marginal effect, the least-productive firms experience negative effects roughly ten times as large, while the most-productive firms experience positive effects roughly three times as large. Additionally, higher temperatures increase exit probability among the least productive firms in warmer regions. I highlight the distributional effects of climate change, and offer insights for adaptation policies.
records.abstract_cn: 本文对温度冲击对欧洲企业造成的经济损失提供了新的企业层面的估计。我依靠面板数据分析来显示温度冲击影响的广泛异质性，这取决于公司特征。本文揭示了微观数据对于量化气候损害估计的重要性，因为温度和经济结果之间的平均关系掩盖了企业对天气冲击的不同敏感性。这些既产生了赢家，也产生了输家，损害了生产力较低的企业，特别是那些位于温暖地区的企业，同时使生产力较高的企业受益。与汇总边际效应相比，生产率最低的企业所经历的负面影响大约是其十倍，而生产率最高的企业所经历的正面影响大约是其三倍。此外，气温升高会增加较温暖地区生产力最低的企业退出的可能性。我强调了气候变化的分配影响，并为适应政策提供了见解。

records.title_en: Right-sizing incentives
records.title_cn: 合理设置激励规模
records.abstract_en: This paper presents results from a field experiment in Nigeria in which expectant mothers were offered cash payments of N2500, N4000 or N10000 conditioned on using formal medical care. A secondary intervention provided some mothers with an information signal about their pregnancy risk. We find highly non-linear effects of conditional payments—most of the incentive effect occurs on the extensive margin, with rapidly diminishing returns to incentive size. We also uncover new spillover effects: showing that incentives increase healthcare use in childhood by index children and by other children in the household. We find largely null effects of the information signal.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了在尼日利亚进行的一项现场实验的结果，其中向准妈妈提供 N2500、N4000 或 N10000 的现金支付，条件是使用正规医疗护理。二次干预为一些母亲提供了有关其怀孕风险的信息信号。我们发现有条件支付的高度非线性效应——大部分激励效应发生在外延边际上，激励规模的回报迅速递减。我们还发现了新的溢出效应：表明激励措施增加了目标儿童和家庭中其他儿童在儿童时期的医疗保健使用。我们发现信息信号的总体上没有明显影响。

records.title_en: Non-normal Empirical Bayes prediction of local welfare
records.title_cn: 局部福利的非正态经验贝叶斯预测
records.abstract_en: Estimates of the area- and household idiosyncratic error distributions from household income and consumption regression models across 142 household surveys from 16 different countries, the type of models that underpin poverty maps, points to significant deviations from normality. The poverty mapping approach put forward by Elbers et al. (2003) demonstrates the value of accommodating this non-normality. Unfortunately, their non-parametric estimator for the error distribution functions does not lend itself for Empirical Bayes (EB) prediction. This paper puts forward an approach that accommodates both EB prediction and non-normally distributed errors. Accounting for non-normality in Empirical Best estimation of local welfare is found to increase precision relative to normal-EB estimation. While the gains in precision range between substantial and marginal, it is always positive. Being able to obtain precise local estimates of welfare help governments and development agencies identify and monitor lagging areas and allocate their resources in a more efficient manner.
records.abstract_cn: 来自142不同国家16家庭调查的家庭收入和消费回归模型对地区和家庭特殊误差分布的估计，即支撑贫困图的模型类型，表明与正态性存在显着偏差。 Elbers 等人提出的贫困绘图方法。 (2003) 证明了适应这种非正态性的价值。不幸的是，他们的误差分布函数非参数估计器不适用于经验贝叶斯 (EB) 预测。本文提出了一种同时适应 EB 预测和非正态分布误差的方法。研究发现，相对于正态 EB 估计，在经验最佳估计中考虑非正态性可以提高当地福利的精确度。虽然精度的提高介于显着和边际之间，但它总是积极的。能够获得准确的当地福利估计有助于政府和发展机构识别和监测落后地区并以更有效的方式分配资源。

records.title_en: Local and spillover effects of trade on structural transformation: Evidence from Brazil
records.title_cn: 贸易对结构转型的本地和溢出效应：来自巴西的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the impact of trade liberalization on structural transformation, leveraging quasi-experimental tariff reductions from Brazil’s 1990s reforms. Building on recent cross-regional macroeconomic literature, we extend the traditional shift-share framework to estimate both local and spatial spillover effects on sectoral employment shares, providing insights into aggregate outcomes. Regions more exposed to tariff reductions experienced a reallocation of employment away from manufacturing and non-tradables and toward primary activities. Consistent with a comparative-advantage channel, the shift toward the primary sector is stronger in regions with higher agricultural potential. Spillover effects — mediated through migration or gravity — partially offset local deindustrialization in manufacturing but amplified declines in non-tradables. These effects persisted over two decades and remained robust to alternative structural transformation hypotheses, concurrent economic shocks, and controls for expenditure exposure. Overall, our findings support theories highlighting comparative advantage as a key driver of trade-induced structural transformation.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用巴西1990改革中的准实验性关税削减，研究了贸易自由化对结构转型的影响。在最近的跨区域宏观经济文献的基础上，我们扩展了传统的转移份额框架，以估计对部门就业份额的本地和空间溢出效应，从而提供对总体结果的见解。更容易受到关税削减影响的地区经历了就业从制造业和非贸易品转向初级活动的重新分配。与比较优势渠道一致，农业潜力较高的地区向第一产业的转变更为强烈。通过移民或重力介导的溢出效应部分抵消了当地制造业的去工业化，但放大了非贸易品的下降。这些影响持续了二十多年，并且对于替代结构转型假设、同时发生的经济冲击和支出风险控制仍然强劲。总体而言，我们的研究结果支持强调比较优势是贸易引发的结构转型关键驱动力的理论。

records.title_en: Government demand and firm growth
records.title_cn: 政府需求与企业增长
records.abstract_en: Public procurement in developing countries accounts for approximately 13% of GDP, offering a significant market opportunity for domestic firms, especially those facing demand constraints. This paper explores the impact of selling to government entities on firm performance in Uganda, leveraging detailed administrative data and an event study methodology that corrects for firm self-selection and heterogeneity in the timing of the treatment. The results reveal that while firms increase their total sales after entering government contracts, they do not see improvements in productivity (measured by value added per worker). Moreover, sales to non-government customers drop sharply. This reallocation effect is persistent. This effect is not observed when firms start to sell to large private-sector buyers. Drawing on an original survey of firms engaged in public procurement, we highlight potential drivers of these dynamics, including capacity constraints and profitability differences between public and private sector sales.
records.abstract_cn: 发展中国家的公共采购约占 GDP 的13%，为国内企业，特别是面临需求限制的企业提供了重要的市场机会。本文利用详细的行政数据和事件研究方法，探讨了向政府实体出售产品对乌干达公司绩效的影响，该方法纠正了公司的自我选择和处理时间的异质性。结果显示，虽然企业在签订政府合同后增加了总销售额，但他们并没有看到生产率的提高（以每个工人的增加值来衡量）。此外，对非政府客户的销售额急剧下降。这种重新分配效应是持久的。当公司开始向大型私营部门买家出售产品时，不会观察到这种效应。根据对从事公共采购的公司的原始调查，我们强调了这些动态的潜在驱动因素，包括能力限制以及公共和私营部门销售之间的盈利能力差异。

records.title_en: Texting parents about early child development: Behavioral changes and unintended social effects
records.title_cn: 向父母发送儿童早期发展短信：行为变化与非预期的社会效应
records.abstract_en: Parenting interventions have the potential to improve early childhood development. Text messages are considered a promising channel to diffuse parenting information at low cost. This paper tests whether sending text messages about parenting practices impacts early childhood development. Households in rural Nicaragua were randomly assigned to receive messages about nutrition, health, stimulation and the home environment. The intervention led to significant changes in self-reported parenting practices. However, it did not improve children’s cognitive development. When local opinion leaders were randomly exposed to the same text message intervention, parental investments declined and children’s outcomes deteriorated. These negative effects were strongest for children of the least educated caregivers. Since interactions between parents and leaders about child development also decreased, the negative effects may have resulted from a crowding-out of efforts by local leaders.
records.abstract_cn: 育儿干预有可能改善儿童早期发展。短信被认为是一种以低成本传播育儿信息的有前景的渠道。本文测试了发送有关育儿实践的短信是否会影响儿童早期发展。尼加拉瓜农村的家庭被随机分配接收有关营养、健康、刺激和家庭环境的信息。干预导致自我报告的育儿实践发生重大变化。然而，它并没有改善儿童的认知发展。当当地意见领袖随机接受相同的短信干预时，父母的投资就会下降，孩子的成绩也会恶化。这些负面影响对于受教育程度最低的照顾者的孩子来说最为严重。由于家长和领导之间关于儿童发展的互动也减少了，负面影响可能是由于当地领导的努力被挤出而造成的。

records.title_en: Housing wealth, family relationship and mental health: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 住房财富、家庭关系与心理健康：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: Mental health conditions are becoming a significant public health concern in the developing world. This paper examines the impact of housing wealth on an individual's mental health through the lens of family relationships. By leveraging the differential effects of China's National Six Policy, which modified down payment ratios and property deed taxes based on house size, we apply a Regression Discontinuity (RD) design to isolate the causal impact of housing wealth shocks on mental health outcomes. The analysis reveals that individuals experiencing positive housing wealth shocks exhibit lower rates of depression, increased life satisfaction, and greater confidence in the future. Additionally, we find that the effects of housing wealth shocks are particularly pronounced for individuals of lower socioeconomic status. The paper further explores the mechanisms through which housing wealth influences mental health, including improved marital satisfaction, stronger parent-child relationships, increased financial investments in children's education, changes in consumption patterns, alterations in employment status, more leisure time, and reduced health risk behaviors. Our findings underscore the substantial impact of housing wealth on enhancing household well-being, particularly in developing countries.
records.abstract_cn: 心理健康状况正在成为发展中国家的一个重大公共卫生问题。本文从家庭关系的角度探讨了住房财富对个人心理健康的影响。通过利用中国国六政策（根据房屋面积修改首付比例和房产契税）的差异效应，我们应用断点回归（RD）设计来识别住房财富冲击对心理健康结果的因果影响。分析显示，经历积极的住房财富冲击的个人抑郁率较低，生活满意度更高，对未来更有信心。此外，我们发现住房财富冲击的影响对于社会经济地位较低的个人尤其明显。论文进一步探讨了住房财富影响心理健康的机制，包括婚姻满意度的提高、亲子关系的加强、儿童教育财政投入的增加、消费模式的改变、就业状况的改变、休闲时间的增加以及健康风险行为的减少。我们的研究结果强调了住房财富对提高家庭福祉的重大影响，特别是在发展中国家。

records.title_en: Large-scale land acquisitions in Ethiopia: Impacts on agricultural productivity and deforestation
records.title_cn: 埃塞俄比亚的大规模土地收购：对农业生产率与森林砍伐的影响
records.abstract_en: Large-scale land acquisitions (LSLAs) have expanded rapidly in developing countries and promoted as a pathway to accelerate agricultural transformation. Yet, credible evidence on their developmental and environmental impacts remains limited. This paper provides causal evidence on the effects of LSLAs on agricultural production and forest outcomes by exploiting spatial and temporal variation in the staggered implementation of LSLAs in Gambella, Ethiopia. We combine geo-referenced administrative records on land transactions (2000–2020) with high-resolution remote sensing data on crop production, forest cover, and land use. Using a heterogeneity robust difference-in-difference estimator, we find no evidence that LSLAs increase agricultural production or the share of crop land. In contrast, it leads to significant and persistent declines in tree cover and forest land share. This deforestation-production paradox suggests that, in settings characterized by weak oversight and insufficient infrastructure, poorly regulated large-scale investments can generate substantial environmental burden without delivering the anticipated structural transformation that justifies them.
records.abstract_cn: 大规模土地收购（LSLA）在发展中国家迅速扩张，并被作为加速农业转型的途径而推广。然而，关于其发展和环境影响的可靠证据仍然有限。本文通过利用埃塞俄比亚甘贝拉交错实施 LSLA 的空间和时间变化，提供了 LSLA 对农业生产和森林成果影响的因果证据。我们将土地交易的地理参考行政记录（2000-2020）与作物生产、森林覆盖和土地利用的高分辨率遥感数据结合起来。使用异质性稳健的双重差分估计器，我们没有发现任何证据表明 LSLA 会增加农业产量或耕地份额。相反，它导致树木覆盖率和林地份额显著且持续的下降。这种毁林-生产悖论表明，在监管薄弱和基础设施不足的环境中，监管不善的大规模投资可能会产生巨大的环境负担，而无法实现预期的结构转型。

records.title_en: The benefits of public transit to households: Evidence from India
records.title_cn: 公共交通给家庭带来的收益：来自印度的证据
records.abstract_en: We measure benefits to households from Mumbai’s new Metro rail system. We estimate a commute mode choice model to value commute time savings in the short run and a housing choice model to value the improved commuting utility that households experience due to spatial sorting. Aggregate benefits from the Metro rail are over 10 times higher when spatial sorting occurs. In the short run women, college-educated workers, and workers with above median incomes experience higher benefits than their opposites. In the long run, households with lower incomes and assets and less than college education benefit more than their wealthier counterparts.
records.abstract_cn: 我们衡量孟买新地铁系统给家庭带来的收益。我们估计了一个通勤模式选择模型，以评估短期内节省的通勤时间，并估计了一个住房选择模型，以评估家庭因空间分选而体验到的通勤效用的改善。当空间分选发生时，地铁的总体效益会高出 10 倍以上。从短期来看，女性、受过大学教育的工人和收入高于中位数的工人比其他人享受到更高的福利。从长远来看，收入和资产较低以及大学教育程度较低的家庭比富裕家庭受益更多。

records.title_en: Who bears the cost: Financial frictions and labor markdown
records.title_cn: 谁承担成本：金融摩擦与劳动力买方压价
records.abstract_en: We present evidence of a connection between bank concentration and labor markdown in China. Using a large dataset on bank branch distribution and firm performance in China, we document that financial friction in the local market leads to significantly higher firm-level labor markdowns but has little impact on firms’ product markup and profitability. This suggests that firms pass the impact of financial friction to the labor market by exploiting labor when faced with higher financial costs. Such transmission of financial friction is more salient among low-skill-intensity or non-state-owned firms, and greater labor mobility facilitates the transmission. Our findings highlight the distributional effect of financial friction in the economy: labor, especially the low-skilled ones, rather than capital, eventually bears the cost of financial friction.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了中国银行集中度与劳动力买方压价之间存在联系的证据。使用有关中国银行分支机构分布和企业绩效的大型数据集，我们发现当地市场的金融摩擦导致企业层面的劳动力买方压价显著更高，但对企业的产品加成和盈利能力几乎没有影响。这表明，当面临更高的融资成本时，企业会通过剥削劳动力将金融摩擦的影响传递给劳动力市场。这种金融摩擦的传导在低技能强度或非国有企业中更为突出，而更大的劳动力流动性则促进了这种传导。我们的研究结果强调了经济中金融摩擦的分配效应：最终承担金融摩擦成本的是劳动力，尤其是低技能劳动力，而不是资本。

records.title_en: Is high-speed internet detrimental for early childhood development? Evidence from a countrywide program
records.title_cn: 高速互联网对儿童早期发育有害吗？来自全国计划的证据
records.abstract_en: We estimate the effects of high-speed internet in early childhood development exploiting cross-cohort and geographic differences in the introduction of fiber-optic-to-the-home. Using variation in lifetime cumulative exposure to fiber optic and combining survey and administrative data, we estimate effects on cognitive and non-cognitive outcomes measured by validated screening tests. We show that an increase in 10 percentage points in lifetime exposure to fiber optic decreases development scores between 6% and 17% of a standard deviation in communication, problem solving and social skills. An analysis of heterogeneous effects shows that the negative impact is larger for children with more educated parents.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用引入光纤到户的跨群体和地理差异来估计高速互联网对儿童早期发展的影响。利用终生累积接触光纤的变化并结合调查和管理数据，我们估计了通过经过验证的筛选测试测量的对认知和非认知结果的影响。我们表明，终生光纤覆盖暴露每增加10个百分点，沟通、问题解决和社交技能的发展得分会下降标准差的6%至17%。异质效应分析表明，父母受教育程度较高的孩子受到的负面影响更大。

records.title_en: Forecasting long-run causal effects
records.title_cn: 预测长期因果效应
records.abstract_en: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) are the gold standard in causal inference. However, it is difficult for decision-makers to rely on RCTs when evaluating interventions that affect long-run outcomes. We elicit 25,980 forecasts from 505 participants to test the ability of people to predict the long-run outcomes of RCTs whose results were unknown to participants. Experienced forecasters, academic experts, and laypeople predict the outcomes of seven RCTs, each of which measured long-run outcomes at time horizons of at least five years. Experienced forecasters and academics were more accurate than laypeople, and experienced forecasters outperformed academics, at least in part due to their superior calibration. Aggregated forecasts outperform individual forecasts, showing a clear wisdom-of-the-crowd effect, but neither experienced forecasters nor academics consistently outperform simple benchmarks. We see no evidence of improved forecasting accuracy from randomly providing participants with additional information about good forecasting practices, details about the RCT interventions, or specifics about the local study context.
records.abstract_cn: 随机对照试验（RCT）是因果推理的黄金标准。然而，决策者在评估影响长期结果的干预措施时很难依赖随机对照试验。我们从25,980参与者那里获得了505预测，以测试人们预测参与者未知的随机对照试验长期结果的能力。经验丰富的预测者、学术专家和外行人士预测了七个随机对照试验的结果，每个试验都测量了至少五年的长期结果。经验丰富的预测者和学者比外行更准确，而经验丰富的预测者的表现优于学者，至少部分原因在于他们具有出色的校准能力。总体预测优于个人预测，显示出明显的群体智慧效应，但经验丰富的预测者和学者都没有始终优于简单的基准。我们没有看到通过随机向参与者提供有关良好预测实践的附加信息、有关 RCT 干预措施的详细信息或有关当地研究背景的具体信息来提高预测准确性的证据。

records.title_en: Labor market competition and inequality
records.title_cn: 劳动力市场竞争和不平等
records.abstract_en: We exploit a novel opportunity to study the dynamics of wage inequality and labor market competition over the course of economic development. Our context is Lithuania, where two decades of sustained growth and labor market tightening coincided with a substantial decline in wage inequality. We first fit a two-way fixed-effects model with worker and firm heterogeneity and document that the compression of the variance of firm fixed effects has been the main source of the fall in inequality. Guided by a standard dynamic monopsony model, we then estimate firms’ labor supply elasticities and show that labor market competition has increased over the same period. Finally, we construct a shift-share instrument and provide evidence that new job opportunities created by the accession to the European Union in 2004 contributed to the fall in inequality through their impact on labor market competition in Lithuania.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用一个新的机会来研究经济发展过程中工资不平等和劳动力市场竞争的动态。我们的背景是立陶宛，该国二十年的持续增长和劳动力市场紧缩与工资不平等的大幅下降同时发生。我们首先拟合了具有工人和企业异质性的双向固定效应模型，并证明企业固定效应方差的压缩是不平等下降的主要根源。然后，在标准动态买方垄断模型的指导下，我们估计了企业的劳动力供给弹性，并表明劳动力市场竞争在同一时期有所加剧。最后，我们构建了一个份额转移工具变量，并提供证据表明，2004年加入欧盟所创造的新就业机会通过对立陶宛劳动力市场竞争的影响，有助于减少不平等。

records.title_en: The complementary role of information and contraceptive access in teen pregnancy
records.title_cn: 信息和避孕药具获取对青少年怀孕的补充作用
records.abstract_en: We investigate how information frictions affect the efficacy of contraception provision programs. We study a Costa-Rican initiative that combined two pillars: free access to long-acting-reversible contraceptives; and a tailored information campaign to raise awareness and correct for baseline misperceptions. Using administrative data and geographic variation in the initiative, we find a 16% decrease in the teen birth rate. We show information complements access: districts exposed to both pillars experience substantially larger reductions than those with contraception access alone. Using surveys on sexual behavior, we show the initiative shifted the information source from personal networks to healthcare professionals, amending misperceptions on sexual health.
records.abstract_cn: 我们调查信息摩擦如何影响避孕提供计划的有效性。我们研究了哥斯达黎加的一项倡议，该倡议结合了两个支柱：免费获得长效可逆避孕药具；以及量身定制的信息活动，以提高认识并纠正基线错误认知。利用该计划中的行政数据和地理差异，我们发现青少年出生率下降了16%。我们展示了信息与获取的补充：接触这两个支柱的地区比单独获取避孕措施的地区经历了更大的减少。通过对性行为的调查，我们表明该计划将信息源从个人网络转移到医疗保健专业人员，从而纠正了对性健康的误解。

records.title_en: Making information actionable: Experimental evidence from Kenyan courts
records.title_cn: 让信息转化为行动：来自肯尼亚法院的实验证据
records.abstract_en: We conduct a randomized controlled trial across Kenyan courts to tackle a major source of court delays: adjournments, i.e., postponements of cases to later dates without reaching a resolution. Partnering with the Kenyan Judiciary, we introduce a simple, cost-effective one-page document that outlines the main reasons for adjournments in each court. We test this intervention in two experimental arms: one where the information is shared with judges, and the other where it is shared with both judges and court user committees. Our intervention successfully prevents approximately 20,000 adjournments nationwide, with each adjournment previously delaying cases by an average of 3 months. The acceleration of court proceedings leads to a notable increase in the demand for and utilization of the legal system, increasing the filing of cases as well as citizen trust in the justice system. Our findings demonstrate that tackling the underlying reasons for court delays can substantially enhance both the perceived and actual performance of judicial systems, fostering greater usage and trust in legal institutions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在肯尼亚法院进行了一项随机对照试验，以解决法庭延误的一个主要根源：休庭，即在没有达成解决方案的情况下将案件推迟到稍后日期。我们与肯尼亚司法机构合作，推出了一份简单、经济高效的单页文件，概述了每个法院休庭的主要原因。我们在两个实验组中测试了这种干预措施：一个与法官共享信息，另一个与法官和法院用户委员会共享信息。我们的干预成功地阻止了全国范围内约 20,000 次延期，之前每次延期案件平均延迟 3 个月。法院诉讼的加速导致对法律系统的需求和利用显著增加，提高了立案率以及公民对司法系统的信任。我们的研究结果表明，解决法院拖延的根本原因可以大大提高司法系统的感知和实际表现，从而促进对法律机构的更多使用和信任。

records.title_en: Evaluating the environmental and economic implications of curbing transboundary pollution: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 遏制跨界污染的环境与经济影响：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: Mitigating transboundary pollution requires internalizing environmental externalities and coordinating inter-jurisdictional interests. This paper examines the environmental and economic consequences of China's watershed ecological compensation (WEC) policy, a government-led property rights allocation scheme that combines Coasean bargaining with state-contingent contracts. By exploiting the progressive roll-out of inter-provincial WEC schemes and employing a difference-in-difference-in-differences design with a novel county-level dataset containing long-term industrial water pollutant information, we find that upstream counties experience significant reductions in pollution emissions but slower economic growth relative to their adjacent downstream counties after policy implementation. Event study estimates further indicate that environmental governance entailing high economic costs is difficult to sustain over time, reflecting a potential misalignment between costs and benefits in environmental protection. These effects can be attributed to pollution-control-oriented policy measures adopted by upstream local governments and the resulting responses of firms and residents. We further show that upstream local governments' prioritization of environmental governance is shaped by both economic and political incentives. Our findings offer insights into institutional design for improving transboundary water quality in countries with decentralized environmental management systems.
records.abstract_cn: 减轻跨境污染需要内部化环境外部性并协调不同辖区之间的利益。本文研究了中国流域生态补偿（WEC）政策的环境和经济后果，这是一种政府主导的产权分配计划，将科斯讨价还价与状态依存合约相结合。通过利用逐步推出的跨省WEC计划，并采用包含长期工业水污染物信息的新型县级数据集的三重差分设计，我们发现政策实施后，上游县的污染排放量显著减少，但相对于邻近下游县的经济增长却放缓。事件研究估计进一步表明，环境治理带来的高昂经济成本难以长期维持，反映出环境保护成本与效益之间潜在的错位。这些影响可以归因于上游地方政府采取的污染控制政策措施以及企业和居民的反应。我们进一步表明，上游地方政府对环境治理的优先顺序是由经济和政治动机共同决定的。我们的研究结果为具有分权式环境管理体系的国家改善跨境水质的制度设计提供了见解。

records.title_en: More power outages, more CO 2 emissions: Evidence from self-generation in China's manufacturing firms
records.title_cn: 更多停电，更多二氧化碳2排放：来自中国制造企业自发电的证据
records.abstract_en: Electricity unreliability is common in developing countries, yet its environmental impacts have rarely been systematically evaluated. We quantify the net impact of power outages on CO2 emissions in China from 2003 to 2010 using a novel framework that captures offsetting responses on both sides of the power system. We find that, in response to province-level grid outages, manufacturing firms fully compensate for the reduced electricity supply from more efficient centralized power plants connected to provincial grids by generating electricity with relatively inefficient captive power plants. This leads to a net increase in nationwide CO2 emissions. Quantitatively, firms’ self-generation responses to power outages in our sample lead to a nationwide net increase of approximately 4.898 million tons of CO2 per year. This self-generation response is concentrated among firms in non-locally supported industries, non-state-owned firms, and non-large taxpayers. Our results highlight the importance of grid investment and carbon offset mechanisms for climate policy in developing countries.
records.abstract_cn: 电力不可靠在发展中国家很常见，但其环境影响却很少得到系统评估。我们使用一种新颖的框架来量化2003至2010期间停电对中国CO2排放的净影响，该框架捕获了电力系统两侧的抵消反应。我们发现，为了应对省级电网停电，制造企业通过使用相对低效的自备电厂发电来充分补偿与省级电网相连的更高效的集中式电厂的电力供应减少。这导致全国CO2排放量净增加。从数量上看，我们样本中的企业对停电的自发电反应导致全国范围内的CO2每年净增加约4.898百万吨。这种自发反应主要集中在非本地支持产业、非国有企业和非纳税大户中。我们的结果凸显了电网投资和碳抵消机制对发展中国家气候政策的重要性。

records.title_en: The power of electricity: Small hydropower and girls’ education
records.title_cn: 电力的力量：小水电和女童教育
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of rural electrification on girls' schooling and later life-course outcomes in rural China. We draw on the Rural Electrification through Small Hydropower (SHP-RE), which was rolled out across counties in three waves during the 1980s and 1990s. Using county-cohort data and a difference-in-differences design, we estimate the effects of exposure to electrification by age 15. SHP-RE increased girls' upper-secondary enrollment by 5.1 percentage points, with no comparable gains for boys. The effects are concentrated among cohorts exposed during later childhood and early adolescence. Exposure also delayed women's age at first marriage and reduced the probability of marrying before age 20. Mechanism evidence is most consistent with reduced domestic labor burden for girls and greater adoption of labor-saving household technology. Counties electrified earlier also later exhibited higher shares of women with upper-secondary education or above and greater enterprise-registration density. Overall, the results show that rural electrification generated large and persistent gains for girls and women at key human-capital and life-course margins.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了农村电气化对中国农村女童就学和以后人生历程结果的影响。我们借鉴了农村小水电电气化（SHP-RE），该项目在1980年代和1990年代分三波在各县推广。使用县级出生队列数据和双重差分设计，我们估计了不同年龄接触电气化的影响15。 SHP-RE 将女生的高中入学率提高了 5.1 个百分点，而男生则没有类似的增幅。影响集中在儿童后期和青春期早期暴露的人群中。暴露还推迟了女性的初婚年龄，并降低了提前结婚的可能性20。机制证据与减少女孩的家务劳动负担和更多地采用节省劳力的家庭技术最为一致。较早通电的县也表现出较高的高中及以上教育程度的女性比例和较高的企业注册密度。总体而言，结果表明，农村电气化为女孩和妇女在关键人力资本和生命历程边缘带来了巨大且持续的收益。

records.title_en: Time-of-day effects on disclosure of intimate partner violence
records.title_cn: 一日内不同时点对亲密伴侣暴力披露的影响
records.abstract_en: Efforts to measure and advance research on intimate partner violence (IPV) often rely on the analysis of data collected from confidential household surveys. Yet, even in confidential settings, women may underreport IPV. I present evidence that, in Sub-Saharan Africa, women with husbands who consume alcohol are 6.4 percentage points less likely to self-report severe physical and/or sexual IPV during evening surveys than during morning surveys. This finding occurs because the expected marginal costs of IPV reporting increase over the day with husbands’ alcohol consumption. My back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that, even if only 10% of interviews conducted by nationally representative IPV survey efforts occur during the evening, time-of-day effects exclude over 314,496 women from estimates of the most severe forms of IPV across Sub-Saharan Africa.
records.abstract_cn: 衡量和推进亲密伴侣暴力 (IPV) 研究的工作通常依赖于对保密家庭调查收集的数据进行分析。然而，即使在保密环境中，女性也可能少报 IPV。我提供的证据表明，在撒哈拉以南非洲，丈夫饮酒的女性在晚间调查期间自我报告严重身体和/或性 IPV 的可能性比早上调查期间要低 6.4 个百分点。出现这一发现是因为 IPV 报告的预期边际成本随着丈夫饮酒量的增加而增加。我的粗略计算表明，即使只有 10% 的全国代表性 IPV 调查工作进行的访谈发生在晚上，一天中的时间效应也会将超过 314,496 名女性排除在撒哈拉以南非洲地区最严重 IPV 形式的估计之外。

records.title_en: The spread of (mis)information: A social media experiment in Pakistan
records.title_cn: （错误）信息的传播：巴基斯坦的社交媒体实验
records.abstract_en: This study examines how controlling misinformation on a social media platform in Pakistan affects users’ exposure to both accurate and false information. It combines an intervention to disseminate official information about the COVID-19 pandemic across the platform with a randomized experiment that measures the impact of fully controlling access to pandemic-related misinformation. The treatments rely on a higher-intensity, ex ante approach to moderating misinformation on the platform relative to the control, which relies on a typical ex post approach to moderation. Fully controlling misinformation, as in the treatments, reduces the number of daily users by 19%, indicating a distaste for moderation. Furthermore, the treatments reduce exposure to official information by 29% more than they reduce exposure to misinformation. A conceptual framework posits that these findings can be explained by the fact that, in this setting, official information is more trusted, and thus is more widely disseminated, relative to misinformation.
records.abstract_cn: 这项研究探讨了控制巴基斯坦社交媒体平台上的错误信息如何影响用户接触准确和虚假信息。它将在整个平台上传播有关新冠肺炎19大流行的官方信息的干预措施与衡量完全控制与大流行相关的错误信息的访问的影响的随机实验相结合。与对照相比，这些处理依赖于更高强度的事前方法来调节平台上的错误信息，而对照则依赖于典型的事后调节方法。完全控制错误信息，就像在治疗中一样，可以使日常用户数量减少19%，这表明人们对节制感到厌恶。此外，这些治疗减少接触官方信息的程度比减少接触错误信息的程度还要多29%。一个概念框架认为，这些发现可以用以下事实来解释：在这种情况下，相对于错误信息，官方信息更值得信赖，因此传播得更广泛。

records.title_en: Political empowerment and marital practices
records.title_cn: 政治赋权和婚姻实践
records.abstract_en: Despite decades of reform, early marriage and dowry remain pervasive in rural India. This paper examines whether women’s political representation shifts these practices. I develop a two-period model in which households choose daughters’ marriage timing and dowry, facing social penalties for non-marriage. Female leaders, by expanding women’s economic opportunities, increase the value of daughters and delay marriage. When social penalties are high, delays also raise dowry demands. I test this using exogenous variation from India’s 1992 constitutional amendment, which reserved one-third of village council (pradhan) seats for women.
